Power up the RB-16

Browsers won't start audio until you ask. Click below to spin up the drum machine — then click the grid to program a beat and hit Play (or the Space bar).

Every drum here is synthesized live with the Web Audio API. No samples are loaded.

Pulseforge · RB-16 · Rhythm Box

A drum machine, in your browser.

Sixteen steps, ten synthesized voices, pattern banks, swing and a full song arranger. The RB-16 schedules every hit against the audio clock with a lookahead window, so the timing stays tight no matter what the page is doing. Program a beat below.
